mintAuthority.summary: apyUSD is an ERC-4626-style strategy wrapper over apxUSD. Ethereum and Base wrappers are UUPS proxies whose mint-critical upgrade paths are controlled by the same 3/6 Safe through chain-local Apyx AccessManagers; durable base issuance is inherited from the reviewed apxUSD issuer authority.

controls.label: apyUSD ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.capDescription: The wrapper mints apyUSD shares through deposit/mint flows against apxUSD; it does not mint base apxUSD.
controls.evidence: Ethereum asset() returned apxUSD address 0x98A878b1Cd98131B271883B390f68D2c90674665 at block 25166610; totalAssets() was nonzero and paused() returned false.

controls.label: apyUSD Base CCIP BurnMintTokenPool

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The Base wrapper's getCCIPPool() returns this Chainlink CCIP BurnMintTokenPool.
routeChecks.caps: The pool can mint only through the verified BridgedApyxToken mint path, which enforces the stored supply cap; it cannot change the cap or upgrade the token.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The verified BridgedApyxToken source gates mint(), burn(), and burnFrom() to the stored CCIP pool; AccessManager separately controls administrative functions and upgrades.

controls.evidence: Re-verified 2026-07-20 at Base block 48862198: the Base apyUSD wrapper's getCCIPPool() returned this pool 0xEd23Fc184a3FE5d12cA92ca4f5CeFa640DECf21d; the pool's getToken() returned the wrapper 0x2c271ddf484ac0386d216eb7eb9ff02d4dc0f6aa and owner() returned the reviewed Apyx 3/6 Safe 0xf9862efc1704ac05e687f66e5cd8c130e5663ce2. Pool bytecode is 13813 bytes, identical to the apxUSD CCIP BurnMintTokenPools on Base and BSC. The pinned Apyx BridgedApyxToken source gates mint()/burn()/burnFrom() to the stored CCIP pool, while AccessManager retains administrative and upgrade functions. authorityType corrected from bridge to contract: the pool is a deployed contract with verified bytecode, not a separate bridge-admin entity (2026-07-15 reads at Base block 48676161 unchanged in effect).

controls.label: Inherited apxUSD signed-order mint authority
controls.evidence: apyUSD inherits the reviewed apxUSD mint-authority profile; Apyx contract documentation describes apxUSD minting through MinterV0 EIP-712 signed orders and AccessManager permissions. The inherited MinterV0 path cannot raise the apxUSD supply cap.

controls.label: Apyx apyUSD UUPS upgrade authority - 3/6 Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530746, the apyUSD proxy implementation slot held 0xfd616567ecc1607f61073951a1e822f7315bb112, authority() returned 0xe167330e2eac88666de253e9607c6d9ae0ca2824, getTargetFunctionRole(proxy, upgradeToAndCall) returned role 24, and the 3/6 Safe held role 24 with a 259200-second delay. At Base block 48620556, the proxy implementation was 0xe167330e2eac88666de253e9607c6d9ae0ca2824, authority() returned 0x8afde6a90d2396a64eb97e8e69e7548289f78a1d, getTargetFunctionRole(proxy, upgradeToAndCall) returned role 25, and the same Safe held role 25 with a 604800-second delay. Official ApyUSD and BridgedApyxToken sources gate _authorizeUpgrade() through AccessManager's restricted modifier.

upgradeability.controlRef: Apyx apyUSD UUPS upgrade authority - 3/6 Safe

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530746, apyUSD is a UUPS proxy with implementation 0xfd616567ecc1607f61073951a1e822f7315bb112 and AccessManager authority 0xe167330e2eac88666de253e9607c6d9ae0ca2824. At Base block 48620556, the bridged apyUSD proxy uses implementation 0xe167330e2eac88666de253e9607c6d9ae0ca2824 and AccessManager authority 0x8afde6a90d2396a64eb97e8e69e7548289f78a1d. Verified Apyx source shows both implementations use UUPS and gate _authorizeUpgrade() with AccessManager restricted; current AccessManager reads resolve roles 24/25 to the same 3/6 Safe with three-day and seven-day delays. Base getCCIPPool() returned 0xEd23Fc184a3FE5d12cA92ca4f5CeFa640DECf21d. Wrapper is not paused and asset() returns apxUSD. apyUSD is an ERC-4626 wrapper of apxUSD (Apyx, BVI), backed by preferred-equity/DAT shares. Wolf & Company, P.C. runs monthly attestations, but the April 2026 engagement narrowed scope to securities only, dropping the cash/stablecoin components covered in March 2026, and apxUSD depegged twice in June 2026 (to ~$0.93 on 2026-06-04 and ~$0.78 on 2026-06-25); no independent reconciliation of the excluded reserve components after 2026-03-31 was confirmed, so reconciliation is unknown. No SEC or BVI FSC fund/issuer registration for Apyx was found, so supervision is none. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: local wrapper mint logic is changeable only through enforced three-day and seven-day delays, while Base supply escapes the Ethereum-only live reconciliation and no local prudential supervisor exists.
